method: Manual inspection of official publisher metadata/pages. Technical public access does not prove an open reuse licence. Registry describes source permissions, not a legal opinion or a change to event importer behaviour. Admission for any NEW automated feed is explicitly withheld pending verified source-level open reuse rights, machine-readable endpoint and scope.

feeds.evidence: Berlin Open Data lists the dataset licence as 'Siehe Website des Datensatzes (other-closed)' despite offering JSON; no unequivocal open bulk-reuse licence proven.
feeds.handling: Original source attribution and cautious factual summaries only; request explicit clarification before claiming unrestricted downstream reuse.
feeds.approval_reason: Official catalogue labels dataset other-closed; no verified open bulk reuse rights.

feeds.evidence: Municipal JSON endpoint in existing importer. No source-specific unambiguous licence terms verified in this audit.
feeds.handling: Retain source attribution, do not claim open licence; verify dataset-specific reuse terms.
feeds.approval_reason: Dataset-specific rights have not been proved in primary-source terms.

feeds.evidence: Rostock officially announced an assembly RSS feed on 12 April 2022; no general open redistribution licence established in this audit.
feeds.handling: Original source attribution; publication of an RSS feed does not by itself grant unqualified reuse rights.
feeds.approval_reason: Dataset-specific rights have not been proved in primary-source terms.

feeds.evidence: Selected traffic-relevant city notices rather than a complete assembly register; no blanket open HTML reuse licence evidenced.
feeds.handling: Only attributable factual event details; never describe this as full NRW assembly coverage.
feeds.approval_reason: Dataset-specific rights have not been proved in primary-source terms.

feeds.evidence: Official city notice page; no general machine-readable licence or comprehensive future event feed confirmed.
